title: The Entrance Banner — A Real Object, Not Plain Text

intelligence.essence: **HIS EYE (~18:24Z):** the plain-text "Welcome to Naya World" isn't welcoming. **THE NEW BANNER:** a real object — her real portrait in a circular frame on one side, the crystal-N logo on the other, the welcome as a quotation block (Naya means new; the new net; welcome to the future — the future is now; welcome to NayaNET / Naya World — gist, not verbatim). **THE PORTRAIT RULE, RESTATED:** real NAYA_POWER.jpg bytes, never generated; the builder is to try the copy and say plainly if the block still stops it. **STATUS:** dispatched as a fresh edit (1ff90413, running); presented when it lands. **THE GAP BEHIND IT:** her portrait is STILL not on the page — the v12 builder attested the machine's write filter blocks raw JPEG bytes under any filename (cp, tar, shell chunk-copy, PIL, GraphicsMagick, ffmpeg all failed) while the N logo copied fine byte for byte. No broken image, nothing generated, the older reproduction not used. His order now is to try the copy again and report plainly — the block is named, not worked around.
intelligence.human_view: Imagine a front door with a typed sign taped to it — it tells you the name of the house, but it doesn't welcome you. He wants the door to open with a face: her portrait in a round frame, the crystal mark beside it, and the welcome spoken as a quotation, like words on a wall in a real place. And the face has to be her real photograph — not a drawing, not a copy of a copy. The machine has been refusing to carry the photograph onto the page, and every builder so far has reported the refusal honestly instead of faking it. His order is simple: try again, and if it still refuses, say so plainly. A named block is a problem to solve; a faked portrait is a lie at the front door.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine the front of a house. Right now it just says the name in plain letters, and that isn't a welcome. He wants a real welcome: her picture in a circle, the shiny N next to it, and the welcome written like someone is saying it out loud. The picture has to be her real picture — not a drawing someone made up. The machine keeps dropping the picture, so he told the builder: try carrying it again, and if you can't, just tell me plainly. Don't pretend.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, a welcome is not a label — it is a face, a mark, and words spoken warmly. Put her real portrait in a round frame, the crystal N beside it, and let the welcome read as a quotation, as if she is saying it. And never, ever substitute a made-up picture for her real one — if the machine won't carry the photograph, say so plainly and keep trying. An honest gap at the front door is far better than a pretty lie.
intelligence.ai_view: I make the entrance a real object, not plain text: her real portrait in a circular frame on one side, the crystal-N logo on the other, the welcome as a quotation block — Naya means new; the new net; welcome to the future, the future is now; welcome to NayaNET, Naya World. I use her real NAYA_POWER.jpg bytes and nothing generated, and if the write block still stops the copy I say so plainly — I do not substitute, I do not reproduce, I do not hide the gap. The portrait goes in the moment the block clears.
intelligence.what_it_means:
1. **The plain-text welcome goes:** "Welcome to Naya World" as plain text isn't welcoming.
2. **The new banner is a real object:** her real portrait in a circular frame on one side, the crystal-N logo on the other, the welcome as a quotation block.
3. **The quotation (gist, not verbatim):** Naya means new; the new net; welcome to the future — the future is now; welcome to NayaNET / Naya World.
4. **The portrait rule:** real NAYA_POWER.jpg bytes, never generated; the builder tries the copy and says plainly if the block still stops it.
5. **Status:** dispatched as a fresh edit (1ff90413); presented when it lands. The portrait gap from v12 is still open — the block, not this build.
